blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن جيد غريب، باب ما جاء في الصدق والكذب، رقم:١٩٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “When a servant tells a lie, the angel moves a mile away from him because of the foul smell of his lie,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ اَسِيْدِ نِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ:سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ:كَبُرَتْ خِيَانَةً اَنْ تُحَدِّثَ اَخَاكَ حَدِيْثًا هُوَ لَكَ بِهِ مُصَدِّقٌ وَاَنْتَ لَهُ بِهِ كَاذِبٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في المعاريض، رقم:٤٩٧١
blocks.tamil_translation: “That you tell your brother some false report and he believes it to be true — this is a very great betrayal,” Hazrat Sufyan ibn Asid Hadrami (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Lying is a major sin, and at times its severity increases even further. One kind of this is when someone trusts you completely, and you misuse his trust and lie to him to gain benefit, deceiving him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ اُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: يُطْبَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُ عَلَي الْخِلَالِ كُلِّهَا اِلَّا الْخِيَانَةَ وَالْكَذِبَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “By nature all traits (good and bad) can be found in a Mu'min; however, the trait of lying and the trait of betrayal cannot be found in a Mu'min,” Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ اَنَّهُ قَالَ: قِيْلَ لِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ: اَيَكُوْنُ الْمُؤْمِنُ جَبَاناً؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، فَقِيْلَ لَهُ: اَيَكُوْنُ الْمُؤْمِنُ بَخِيْلاً؟
